name: hiui-design

capabilities.name: standard-page-task-single-entry
capabilities.description: Run the official single-entry closure for standard typical page generation: brief, managed write, and slot gate.

capabilities.name: page-task-preflight
capabilities.description: Run the lightweight host-compatibility gate that decides whether a hiui-design page task may start.

capabilities.name: non-typical-page-task-execution
capabilities.description: Run the minimal validated-v1 non-typical page closure for upper-layer callers.

capabilities.name: page-task-planning
capabilities.description: Generate the S1 machine plan that hiui-page-workflow consumes before any page edits.

capabilities.name: public-cli-contracts
capabilities.description: Describe the public CLI surface that other skills may depend on.

capabilities.name: preview-runtime
capabilities.description: Start the packaged preview runtime that renders official typical-page references without materializing preview assets into target projects.

notes: This manifest exposes the minimum stable install/runtime contract used by hiui-page-workflow.
The public rules surface is documented under docs/ and materialized via scripts/plan-page-task.mjs rather than a second generator skill.
